title: How a Water Filter Works in 60 Seconds 🚰💧 #shorts
description:
A pitcher water filter works in layers. A mesh stops grit, activated carbon grabs chlorine taste and odour on its huge pore surface, and ion-exchange beads swap metals like lead and copper for harmless ions. Gravity does all the pumping. Follow Inside 60 for a new "how it works" explained in 60 seconds.

#waterfilter #activatedcarbon #howitworks

steps.label: Hook
steps.text: One gram of *activated carbon* hides over 500 square metres of surface.

steps.label: Gravity
steps.text: Tap water sits on top, and *gravity* pulls it down through the cartridge.

steps.label: Mesh
steps.text: A fine *mesh* stops sand and grit first.

steps.label: Carbon
steps.text: Carbon's maze of pores *traps chlorine* and the chemicals that cause bad taste and smell.

steps.label: Resin
steps.text: *Ion-exchange beads* grab metals like lead and copper, swapping in harmless ions.

steps.label: Clean
steps.text: Cleaner water drips into the *pitcher* below, ready to pour.

steps.label: Recap
steps.text: Strain, *trap*, swap. Follow Inside 60 for more.
